audit_items.proof_trace: The dedup check `contains_key(...) && !block_seen` is completely bypassed when block_seen=true, allowing duplicate sidecars with the same (slot, proposer_index, index) to be re-accepted and re-validated. The `&& !block_seen` clause causes the guard to fail for previously-seen blocks, contradicting the spec requirement for first-sidecar-only acceptance.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends duplicate data column sidecars for a seen block_root; each bypass triggers full cryptographic validation (signature verification at L2116-2125, KZG proofs), causing CPU exhaustion DoS without requiring new unique data.
